title: Happy sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Branch -->
  <rect x='8' y='72' width='84' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#6b4a2b'/>
  <rect x='8' y='72' width='84' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a6039'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#a07a4e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#c49a68'/>
  <!-- Arms reaching to branch -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='62' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#8f6b42' transform='rotate(18 27 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='62' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#8f6b42' transform='rotate(-18 73 62)'/>
  <!-- Claws on branch -->
  <rect x='22' y='70' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e8d3a8'/>
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e8d3a8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='70' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e8d3a8'/>
  <rect x='74' y='70' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e8d3a8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='21' ry='18' fill='#b08553'/>
  <!-- Face mask lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e2c69a'/>
  <!-- Eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='7' ry='6.5' fill='#4a3324'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='31' rx='7' ry='6.5' fill='#4a3324'/>
  <!-- Eyes happy closed arcs -->
  <path d='M36 31 Q41 26 46 31' stroke='#ffe9b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 31 Q59 26 64 31' stroke='#ffe9b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#3d2a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='39' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#6e5238'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 45 Q50 51 57 45' stroke='#7a5130' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='40' r='3' fill='#e8a27e'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='40' r='3' fill='#e8a27e'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='5' fill='#a07a4e'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='5' fill='#a07a4e'/>
</svg>
